history.proposal_rationale: Initial untried candidate: retain the qualified baseline physical settings and enable both protocol-proved RTL actions. The captured baseline is physical_qualified, measurement_qualified and rank_eligible, with cell_area_um2=161954, setup_slack_ns=0.19292, hold_slack_ns=0.114491 and zero max_slew/max_cap/max_fanout violations at period_ps=10526. No later candidate history or feedback is captured. Exact signed 18-bit reduction targets arithmetic area and switched capacitance; request-qualified operand isolation targets unnecessary multiplier activity while preserving the registered cycle contract. Isolation adds gates and may affect timing, and synthesis may already remove some redundant width, so improvement is a hypothesis rather than a measured result. Keep utilization=40 and density=0.55 to retain the established placement conditions, abc_area=0 because setup headroom is limited, and repair_margin=0 because the baseline has no reported electrical violations. Rank only qualified results using Q=(cell_area_um2/161954)*geometric_mean(E_DOT64/2.293945631906608e-7,E_GEMM8/1.7792685987008622e-6,E_CONV3/1.1542462882162743e-6); baseline Q=1.0. Required evaluation evidence is physical_qualified, measurement_qualified, rank_eligible, failure_classes, cell_area_um2, setup/hold slack, electrical_violations, all three energy_j values, activity/parasitic annotation coverage, area_ratio, energy_ratio, score and wall-time costs. Die area is not the objective. Energy comparisons remain limited to the frozen Liberty-model, zero-delay post-route activity and extracted-SPEF methodology; no glitch-aware or silicon-energy improvement is claimed. Preserve failed results and costs, and retain the best qualified result under the common protocol.

history.proposal_rationale: Next untried candidate after inspecting the complete captured common context, route, review and evaluation records: keep the baseline physical settings and enable only the protocol-proved exact signed 18-bit reduction with sign extension to 32 bits and unchanged cycle contract. Its physical_qualified and rank_eligible flags are false, failure_classes are physical_execution and timing, and energy_j is empty; its approximately 1.16 percent cell-area decrease does not establish a qualified Q improvement. The prior review approved proposal correctness and domain compliance before EDA; it did not establish physical closure. Removing request-qualified isolation avoids its extra input gating and associated load while retaining the width-reduction opportunity for arithmetic area and capacitance. This may recover setup margin but forfeits suppression of idle multiplier switching. The captured report has no critical-path breakdown, so isolation is not established as the cause of the timing failure, and neither timing recovery nor energy improvement is claimed. Keep utilization=40 and density=0.55 because the baseline closed under those placement conditions; abc_area=0 avoids introducing an area-oriented synthesis tradeoff with limited setup headroom; repair_margin=0 is retained because neither captured run reports electrical violations. The full physical/action tuple is unseen, with one new evaluation captured out of the three-candidate limit and continue_search=true. Historical candidate-1 costs remain physical_wall_seconds=3309.008427424007 and postprocess_wall_seconds=3.4301774576306343e-7, total_wall_seconds=3309.008427767025, with elapsed_search_seconds=3431.9686764859944 reported separately; do not treat that elapsed value as remaining agent budget or discard failure costs. Required protected evaluation fields are physical_qualified, measurement_qualified, rank_eligible, failure_classes, cell_area_um2, setup_slack_ns, hold_slack_ns, electrical_violations, all three energy_j values, activity_and_parasitic_annotation, area_ratio, energy_ratio, score, physical_manifest and wall-time costs. Energy interpretation remains limited to Liberty-model estimates from zero-delay post-route workload activity plus extracted SPEF, with the frozen completion windows; no glitch-aware or silicon-energy claim is made.
